From the kitchen

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

Fish House on the harbour

Fish House sits right on Ayia Napa harbour, at the end of Archbishop Makariou Avenue: an entrance under the red lobster sign, a covered terrace with white chairs looking out to the sea, and a playground for the children. The fish is chosen from the display and priced by the portion or by the kilo. On Google, guests mention the sea view and the sunsets, the fresh fish, the seafood platter and the fish meze, and on some evenings there is a buffet with sushi.

Open every day from 12:00 to 23:00. Birthdays and christenings on request.
